instruction: Implement the `LRUCache` class in lru.py (currently a stub) per its docstring: `LRUCache(capacity)` raises ValueError if capacity < 1; `put(key, value)` inserts or updates and marks the key most-recently used, evicting the least-recently used key when the cache would exceed capacity; `get(key, default=None)` returns the value and marks the key most-recently used, or returns `default` (without changing recency) if absent; `key in cache` does NOT change recency; `len(cache)` is the number of entries; `keys()` returns a list of keys from least- to most-recently used; `evictions` is an int attribute counting evictions so far. Updating an existing key never evicts. Stored values like None must be distinguishable from missing keys via `default`. All tests in tests/test_lru.py must pass.
